d:
Fall in love with the romantic melody "O Dil Jaani" from Udhar Ka Sindoor. Sung by Kishore Kumar and Anuradha Paudwal, this beautiful song features Jeetendra, Reena Roy, and Asha Parekh.
Credits:
Song Name: O Dil Jaani
Singers: Kishore Kumar, Anuradha Paudwal
Music: Rajesh Roshan
Lyrics: Majrooh Sultanpuri
Movie: Udhar Ka Sindur (1976)
Cast: Jeetendra, Reena Roy, Asha Parekh
